title: Heap Out-of-Bounds Read in µD3TN BPv6/BPv7 Fragmenter allows Local Attacker to Read Memory and Reliably Cause DoS…
description: CVE-2026-121511 is a heap out-of-bounds read vulnerability in the µD3TN BPv6/BPv7 Fragmenter component. It allows a local attacker to read memory beyond the intended buffer and reliably cause a denial-of-service (DoS) condition. The vulnerability has a CVSS 3.1 score of 7.1, indicating high severity. No affected versions or patch information are provided in the available data.
